attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited received a Letter of Commencement from the Central Public Works Department on 19th November 2026. The order is for the planning, designing, and construction of residential and non-residential infrastructure for the CISF 12th Reserve Battalion at Village Jamunia Talab, Dist. Sehore, Madhya Pradesh. The project is executed on an EPC Mode-I basis. The contract duration is 2 Years. The total consideration for the order is Rs.1,98,30,99,984.08. The awarding entity is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by the promoter or promoter group companies in the entity that awarded the order. The order does not fall within related party transactions. This announcement is made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited entered into a contract agreement on 19th November 2026 with the National Highways Authority of India for toll collection operations at the Palayam Fee Plaza in Tamil Nadu. The company will undertake toll collection and maintain the adjacent toilet block starting from 24th November 2026 for a period of one year. The contract is valued at Rs. 3,40,07,77,777. This engagement is based on competitive bidding through E-Tender for the Krishnagiri to Thumbipadi section of NH-44 on a BOT basis. The entity awarding the order is a domestic entity. There are no related party transactions or promoter interests involved in this contract.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited entered into a contract agreement on 19th November 2026 with the National Highways Authority of India for the operation and maintenance of the Baiti Kala Fee Plaza in Uttar Pradesh. The company will undertake toll collection and maintain adjacent toilet blocks for a period of one year, commencing from 30th December 2026. The contract covers the four-lane Sultanpur-Varanasi section of National Highway number 56. The total consideration for the order is Rs. 91,77,77,777. The entity awarding the order is a domestic entity. There is no interest held by promoters or promoter group companies in the awarding entity. The contract does not fall within related party transactions. This announcement is made under Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited published a newspaper advertisement on 16th November 2026 regarding the disclosure of Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The announcement was made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The advertisement appeared in the Financial Express in English and Indore Samachar in Hindi. The financial results are available on the company website at www.highwayinfrastructure.in. The notice was issued by Palak Rathore, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has submitted the Exchange a copy Srutinizers report of  Extraordinary General Meeting held on November 13, 2026. Further, the company has informed the Exchange regarding voting results.
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited has disclosed the voting results for its first Extraordinary General Meeting held on 13th November 2026. The company reports that Resolution 1, an ordinary resolution to increase authorized share capital, was passed with 99.98 percent votes in favor. Resolution 2, a special resolution regarding the preferential allotment of convertible warrants to promoters, was also passed with 99.41 percent votes in favor. The total number of shareholders on the record date was 51,679. Voting was conducted via electronic means. The consolidated Scrutiniser's Report is attached to the disclosure. The results are reported as final in this filing.

attchmntText: Highway Infrastructure Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Highway Infrastructure Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board took on record the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued a Limited Review Report on these results. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 6,080.02 million. Net profit for the half year was Rs. 107.92 million. Earnings per share for the half year was Rs. 2.53. Total assets as at 30th September 2026 stood at Rs. 4,125.74 million. Total equity was Rs. 2,396.08 million. The results are available on the company website.
